domain_zh: 实证研究/语言田野调查
definition_zh: 以长期亲身走访替代书斋转述：为记录突厥语诸方言，喀什噶里在约1057年离开故乡后，用十五至二十年时间穿行突厥诸部的城市、草原、山地与沙漠，与操不同方言的部落共同生活，直接向母语者采集词汇、谚语、诗歌与风俗材料。他自述'我走遍了突厥人的所有城市与草原'，并强调即便自己已是最精通诸方言者，仍坚持亲历亲录。此方法的核心逻辑：关于一种活语言的可靠知识只能来自第一手现场；二手转述会丢失音值、用法与语境。这使《词典》成为田野调查式的语言学著作，被后世视为中世纪语言田野研究的先例。
definition_en: Replace second-hand compilation with long-term first-hand fieldwork: to record the Turkic dialects, al-Kashgari left his homeland c.1057 and spent fifteen to twenty years traversing the cities, steppes, mountains and deserts of the Turkic tribes, living among speakers of different dialects and collecting vocabulary, proverbs, poetry and customs directly from native speakers. He states that he 'visited all the cities and steppes of the Turks,' stressing that even as the most eloquent of them he still insisted on personal witness. Core logic: reliable knowledge of a living language can only come from the field; second-hand transmission loses phonetics, usage and context. This made the Diwan a work of fieldwork linguistics, regarded as a medieval precedent for linguistic field research.
source_chapter: 《突厥语大词典》前言自述（Dankoff & Kelly 英译本 1982, vol.1 pp.70-86，据 MS.2-28）；TDK《Kâşgarlı Mahmud》条目（'yirmi yıla yakın malzeme topladıktan sonra 1072 yılında Bağdat'a gelmiş'）；Turkic Studies Journal（Tchoroev 2026）；linearhistory 'father of Turkology' 条目
key_quote_zh: 我虽然已是他们中语言最流利、口才最好、心智最细、血统最正、最善用矛的人，仍然走访了突厥人、土库曼人、乌古斯人、奇吉尔人、亚格马人和柯尔克孜人的城市与草原，收集他们的方言与韵语。
key_quote_en: Although I was the most eloquent of them in language and speech, the most refined in intellect, the most firmly rooted in lineage, and the best spear-thrower, I still travelled through the cities and steppes of the Turks, Turkmens, Oghuz, Chigils, Yagmas and Kyrgyz, collecting their dialects and rhymes.
process_zh: 离开书斋：以政治流亡为契机，主动进入突厥诸部的真实语言环境
规划路线：从伊犁河谷、七河地区到锡尔河流域，覆盖各主要部落分布区
沉浸接触：与各部落共同生活，学习其方言、习俗与口头文学
即时记录：随身记录听到的词汇、谚语、诗歌与韵语
长期积累：以约十五至二十年的持续采集形成大规模一手语料
交叉回访：在不同部落间反复核对同一词条的说法差异
process_en: Leave the study: turn political exile into direct entry into the living language environment of the Turkic tribes
Plan the route: cover major tribal areas from the Ili valley and Semirechye to the Syr Darya basin
Immerse: live among the tribes and learn their dialects, customs and oral literature
Record on the spot: note down words, proverbs, verses and rhymes as heard
Accumulate over time: build a large first-hand corpus through roughly fifteen to twenty years of collection
Cross-check: re-verify disputed forms with different tribal groups
representative_cases_zh: 十五年以上的实地穿行：据传记线索，喀什噶里离开喀什噶尔后，用约15-20年时间走遍突厥诸部——从伊犁河谷、七河地区（Semirechye）到锡尔河流域，再到布哈拉、撒马尔罕、梅尔夫、内沙布尔等学术城市
向母语者采集方言材料：《词典》为数百个词条标注部落方言归属（研究统计：仅乌古斯标注即达265处，钦察53处、奇吉尔51处、阿尔古45处），全部来自实地采录
记录口头文学的现场样本：挽歌《阿尔普·艾尔·通阿》、大量民歌四行诗与谚语均采自部落民众之口，而非文人转抄
representative_cases_en: Over fifteen years of travel: according to biographical clues, al-Kashgari spent some 15-20 years traversing the Turkic lands—from the Ili valley and Semirechye to the Syr Darya basin, and on to the scholarly cities of Bukhara, Samarkand, Merv and Nishapur
Collecting dialect material from native speakers: the Diwan tags hundreds of entries by tribe (studies count 265 Oghuz tags, 53 Kipchak, 51 Chigil, 45 Arghu), all gathered in the field
Recording living samples of oral literature: the elegy for Alp Er Tunga, folk quatrains and proverbs were taken from the mouths of tribal people rather than copied from literati texts
modern_applications_zh: 人类学与语言田野调查
跨文化用户研究
一线走访与下沉市场调研

verification.evidence: DLT 前言（Dankoff & Kelly 1982, vol.1 pp.70-86）；TDK Kâşgarlı Mahmud 条目；Tchoroev (2026) Turkic Studies Journal；Killi (2008) 方言标注统计（转引自 Türk Maarif Ansiklopedisi）

definition_zh: 对同时代突厥语各方言做系统性的比较、分类与逐词标注：先按部落建立谱系（自称'突厥本为二十部'，自拜占庭边境向西向东排列至中国），再为词条逐一注明'某词用于乌古斯''奇吉尔与亚格马如此说'，并归纳音变规则与语法差异。他还建立方言评价标准：最纯正者为亚格马与托赫西方言，最优雅者为汗族（喀喇汗宫廷）方言，最简明者为乌古斯语；并指出单语人群的语音最纯正，城市双语者'言语含混'。此方法的核心逻辑：比较的价值在于标注——每个词都带着它的出处、变体与使用社群；分类不仅是整理，更是判断力的表达。
definition_en: Systematically compare, classify and annotate contemporary Turkic dialects: first build a tribal taxonomy (he claims 'the Turks are twenty tribes,' ordered from the Byzantine frontier eastward to China), then tag entries word by word ('this word belongs to the Oghuz,' 'the Chigil and Yagma say it so'), while generalizing sound changes and grammatical differences. He also sets evaluative criteria: the most correct dialects are Yagma and Tukhsi, the most elegant is the Khakani (Karakhanid court) dialect, the clearest is Oghuz; and he observes that monolinguals speak most purely while bilingual city-dwellers have 'a certain slurring.' Core logic: comparison lives in annotation—every word carries its provenance, variants and speech community; classification is not filing but judgement.
source_chapter: DLT'te 'Türk Boyları Üzerine Söz' 与 'Türk Dilleri Üzerine Söz' 两节（转引自 TDK Dîvânu Lugâti't-Türk 条目；Türk Maarif Ansiklopedisi；A. Karahan《Divanu Lugati't Türk'e Göre XI. Yüzyıl Türk Lehçe Bilgisi》2013）；英文维基 'Mahmud al-Kashgari'（纯度评价引文）；DergiPark《DİVÂNU LUGÂTİ'T-TÜRK'TE YAĞMA BOYU》
key_quote_zh: 突厥语中最简明的是乌古斯语，最正确的是亚格马与托赫西方言；最优雅的方言属于只懂一种语言、不与波斯人杂处、不习惯定居他乡的人。那些操两种语言、与城市人群杂处的人，言语中总带着某种含混。
key_quote_en: The clearest of the Turkic tongues is Oghuz; the most correct are the dialects of Yagma and Tukhsi; the most elegant of the dialects belongs to those who know only one language, who do not mix with Persians and who do not customarily settle in other lands. Those who have two languages and who mix with the populace of the cities have a certain slurring in their utterances.
process_zh: 建立部落清单：核实并登记二十个主要部落及其分支
确定比较维度：词汇、语音、语法、韵文各层面并置对照
逐词标注归属：为词条注明所属部落方言与使用地区
归纳差异规则：记录同一现象在不同部落的音值差异与形态规则
建立评价等级：以纯正度、优雅度、简明度为方言排序
输出方言地图：将部落分布按拜占庭边境至中国的顺序空间化
process_en: List the tribes: verify and register the twenty main tribes and their branches
Fix comparison dimensions: juxtapose lexicon, phonetics, grammar and verse across dialects
Annotate every entry: mark the dialect and region each word belongs to
Generalize divergence rules: record phonetic and morphological differences for the same phenomenon
Set evaluation tiers: rank dialects by correctness, elegance and clarity
Output a dialect map: spatialize tribal distribution from the Byzantine frontier to China
representative_cases_zh: 二十部族序列：自西向东为佩切涅格、钦察、乌古斯、耶麦克、巴什基尔、拔悉密、Kay、牙巴库、鞑靼、柯尔克孜、奇吉尔、托赫西、亚格马、乌古拉克、察鲁克、丘穆尔、回鹘、唐古特、契丹、桃花石（Tavgaç），并注明各部落所在
逐词归属标注：研究统计显示方言标注词数多达数百处（乌古斯265、钦察53、奇吉尔51、阿尔古45、肯捷克22、亚格马22、回鹘12……），构成中世纪最系统的方言词库
乌古斯专章：记录22个乌古斯部落的名称与牲畜印记（damga），因其与塞尔柱政权崛起相关
语音规则对照：如名词时间-地点形式在奇吉尔、亚格马、托赫西、阿尔古、回鹘方言中以-y（yayın/vav）构成，而在乌古斯、钦察、佩切涅格、保加尔方言中以-sı/-si 构成
representative_cases_en: The twenty-tribe sequence: Pecheneg, Kipchak, Oghuz, Yemek, Bashkir, Basmyl, Kay, Yabaku, Tatar, Kyrgyz, Chigil, Tukhsi, Yagma, Ughrak, Charuk, Chumul, Uyghur, Tangut, Khitai, Tavghach—with their locations noted

Word-by-word attribution: studies count hundreds of dialect-tagged items (Oghuz 265, Kipchak 53, Chigil 51, Arghu 45, Kenchek 22, Yagma 22, Uyghur 12, etc.), forming the most systematic medieval record of Turkic dialect words
A special Oghuz chapter: names and livestock tamgas of 22 Oghuz tribes, reflecting the rise of the Seljuk polity
Phonetic rules compared: e.g., deverbal nouns of time/place are formed with -y in Chigil, Yagma, Tukhsi, Arghu and Uyghur, but with -sı/-si in Oghuz, Kipchak, Pecheneg and Bulgar
modern_applications_zh: 语料库标注与数据治理
区域市场方言分层
竞品差异的结构化对比

verification.evidence: TDK Dîvânu Lugâti't-Türk 条目；Türk Maarif Ansiklopedisi；Karahan (2013)；DergiPark Yağma 研究；英文维基 Mahmud al-Kashgari 条目

definition_zh: 借用成熟的阿拉伯辞书学框架来组织突厥语材料，并在借用中明确改造：以哈利勒·伊本·艾哈迈德《阿因书》（Kitāb al-Ayn）为体例样板，采用阿拉伯词法分类（八种词形类别）与字母序编排，把词条分为八大'书'（hamz、salim、mudha'af、mithal、中间弱化、末尾弱化、鼻音、双辅音相连），每书再分名词与动词、按二至七字母递进；书名则化用法拉比《Diwan al-Adab》的题式但改用复数'诸语言'。他明确声明'我的做法更正确'：只收常用词、舍弃废弃词以求简明。据转述他还曾在两年内三易其稿、第四次才定稿。此方法的核心逻辑：框架移植不是照搬，而是'借形改质'——用读者熟悉的容器装本文明的内容，并按素材特性修正容器。
definition_en: Borrow the mature Arabic lexicographical framework to organize Turkic material—and consciously improve it in the borrowing: adopting al-Khalil ibn Ahmad's Kitab al-Ayn as the structural model, using Arabic morphological categories (eight word classes) and alphabetical ordering, dividing entries into eight 'books' (hamz, salim, mudha'af, mithal, medial-weak, final-weak, nasal, double-consonant clusters), each split into nouns and verbs and ordered from two- to seven-letter words; while the title echoes al-Farabi's Diwan al-Adab but switches to the plural 'lughat' (languages). He explicitly claims 'my method is more correct': keeping only used words and dropping obsolete ones for brevity; reports say he rewrote the work three times in two years before the fourth, definitive draft. Core logic: transplantation is not copying but 'borrowing the form while reshaping its substance'—putting a civilization's content into a familiar vessel, then correcting the vessel to fit the material.
source_chapter: DLT 前言及辞典结构说明（据 Yusuf Doğan《Kâşgarlı Mahmûd'un Dîvânu Lugâti't-Türk Adlı Eserinin Dilbilim Açısından İncelenmesi》转译 DLT I.36-38）；Tchoroev (2026) Turkic Studies Journal（法拉比题式）；Dankoff & Kelly (1982) Part I 'Structure of the Diwan'；Atalay《DLT Tercümesi》c.1（四易其稿转述）
key_quote_zh: 为了表明突厥语与阿拉伯语并驾齐驱、地位相当，我萌生了按哈利勒·艾哈迈德《阿因书》的方式著书、兼录常用与废弃之词的想法。那种体例更为完备，但我的做法更正确：我只收录常用词，为求简明而舍弃废弃不用的词。
key_quote_en: To show that the Turkic languages keep pace with Arabic on an equal footing, it occurred to me to write a book in the manner of al-Khalil ibn Ahmad's Kitab al-Ayn, mentioning both used and unused words. That way would be more comprehensive, but my method is more correct: I recorded the used and abandoned the unused in the interest of brevity.
process_zh: 选定样板：以《阿因书》等权威阿拉伯辞书为体例参照
移植分类：采用阿拉伯词法八类作为顶层结构
适配素材：每类先名词后动词、按词的长短由二字母递进至七字母
增补检索：确保使用者能按字母顺序在正确位置找到词条
改造优化：舍弃废弃词、按突厥语实际调整规则，并声明改进之处
反复重写：短期内多稿迭代，直至体例与素材完全贴合
process_en: Choose the model: take authoritative Arabic dictionaries such as the Kitab al-Ayn as the structural reference
Transplant the classification: adopt the eight Arabic morphological classes as the top-level structure
Fit the material: within each class, nouns before verbs, ordered from two-letter words up to seven letters
Add retrieval aids: ensure the user finds each entry in its proper place by alphabetical order
Improve and adapt: drop obsolete words, adjust rules to actual Turkic facts, and state the improvements
Rewrite iteratively: produce several drafts in quick succession until form and material fully fit
representative_cases_zh: 《阿因书》样板：明确以哈利勒·伊本·艾哈迈德（al-Khalīl b. Aḥmad）的阿拉伯语词典为蓝本，并借鉴其'常用/废弃'词条处理思路
题式改造：书名仿法拉比《Divan al-Adab fi Bayani Lughat al-'Arab》，但把单数'语言'改为复数'诸语言'（lughāt），暗示突厥语是一个语族而非一种语言
八书结构：hamz（喉塞起首）、salim（健全词）、mudha'af（重叠）、mithal（首弱）、中弱、末弱、ghunna（鼻音 nğ/nç）、两静符相连——逐级细分，兼容名词与动词
四易其稿：据 Atalay 转述传统记载，他在两年内三稿皆不满意，第四次才作为定本写成
representative_cases_en: The Kitab al-Ayn model: he explicitly modelled his work on al-Khalil ibn Ahmad's Arabic dictionary, including its treatment of 'used/unused' entries
Reworking the title: echoing al-Farabi's Diwan al-Adab fi Bayani Lughat al-'Arab but switching to the plural 'lughat' (languages), implying Turkic is a family of languages

The eight-book structure: hamz (glottal-initial), salim (sound), mudha'af (doubled), mithal (initial-weak), medial-weak, final-weak, ghunna (nasal nğ/nç), and double-sukun clusters—progressively subdivided for nouns and verbs
Four drafts: according to the tradition transmitted by Atalay, he wrote the work three times in two years, unsatisfied each time, before producing the definitive fourth draft
modern_applications_zh: 国际标准与框架的本地化改造
数据库与知识库的结构设计
跨界方法论的移植与再创造
modern_applications_en: Transplanting and reinventing methodologies across domains

verification.evidence: Dogan 论文（DergiPark 303730）转译 DLT I.36-38；Tchoroev (2026)；Dankoff & Kelly (1982) Part I；Atalay DLT Tercümesi c.1 p.XIV

domain_zh: 跨文明对话/文化主体性
definition_zh: 以论证与修辞为突厥语（及其文明）在伊斯兰知识世界争取与阿拉伯语对等的地位：用'两匹赛马并驾齐驱'的比喻宣示语言平等；引述'学习突厥语，因他们的统治将长久'的圣训作为权威加持（同时坦承其传述链存疑，把责任归于提供者）；全书以伊斯兰世界的通用语阿拉伯语书写、以对方熟悉的经典体裁呈现，让被书写者与书写者站上同一水平线；并强调'突厥人极其珍视自己的语言，对懂突厥语者怀有特别好感'。此方法的核心逻辑：文明地位不是被恩赐的，而是通过话语工程争取来的——用主流世界的标准证明自身不逊色，把政治现实转化为文化承认的论据。
definition_en: Use argument and rhetoric to win for the Turkic language (and its civilization) parity with Arabic in the Islamic learned world: declare linguistic equality through the 'two horses in a race' simile; invoke the hadith 'learn the tongue of the Turks, for their reign will be long' for authoritative support (while candidly noting its chain of transmission is suspect and shifting responsibility to its transmitters); write the whole work in Arabic, the lingua franca of the Islamic world, in genres familiar to its audience, placing the described and the describer on one level; and stress that 'the Turks greatly honour their language and show special affection to those who speak it.' Core logic: civilizational status is not granted but won through discursive engineering—prove you are no less by the standards of the mainstream, and convert political fact into an argument for cultural recognition.
source_chapter: DLT 前言（'两匹赛马'句，据 Dankoff & Kelly 英译本；转引自 Dankoff《From Mahmud Kaşgari to Evliya Çelebi》）；Dogan 论文（写作目的：教阿拉伯人突厥语、证明突厥语与阿拉伯语同等丰富）；TDK DLT 条目；iie.kz（'两匹马'与语言尊严引文）
key_quote_zh: 为使突厥语与阿拉伯语像两匹赛马一样并驾齐驱，我在书中缀满了他们吟诵的诗句，以及他们按照智慧之道铸造的谚语——无论顺境逆境，口口相传。
key_quote_en: In order to show that the Turkic dialects keep pace with Arabic like two horses in a race, I have strewn therein examples of their verses, which they utter in their pronouncements and declarations, as well as proverbs which they coin according to the ways of wisdom, both in adversity and in felicity, and which are handed down from speaker to speaker.
process_zh: 锁定对话对象：阿拔斯哈里发宫廷及阿拉伯语知识界
选择普世标尺：以'丰富、精确、典雅'等对方承认的标准衡量突厥语
构造核心隐喻：'两匹赛马'——不争高下、只求并驾齐驱
借力权威话语：引述圣训为突厥语增添宗教-政治正当性（并标注存疑）
以内容自证：用大量诗歌谚语实例证明论证，而非空言
争取制度承认：把成书献给哈里发，将语言平等落为公开事实
process_en: Fix the interlocutor: the Abbasid caliphal court and the Arabic-reading learned public
Choose universal yardsticks: measure Turkic by criteria the audience already accepts—richness, precision, elegance
Build the core metaphor: 'two horses in a race'—no contest for supremacy, only parity
Borrow authoritative discourse: invoke the hadith to add religio-political legitimacy (while flagging its doubtful chain)
Let the content argue: prove the claim with abundant verses and proverbs rather than assertion
Seek institutional recognition: dedicate the work to the caliph and turn parity into a public fact
representative_cases_zh: 两匹赛马：以竞赛隐喻替代尊卑隐喻，为突厥语设定'并驾齐驱'的目标——这是全书的总纲性论证
圣训引用与存疑处理：援引'学习突厥语'的圣训增强正当性，同时注明'若此圣训可靠'并把传述责任归于两位伊玛目——争取权威而不伪造权威
写作目的声明：学界普遍认定《词典》旨在教阿拉伯人学会突厥语、证明突厥语'与阿拉伯语同样强健、在社会重要性上不逊色'，并将突厥语引入当代伊斯兰文明的知识世界
语言尊严观察：记录'突厥人极其珍视自己的语言，对说突厥语者怀有特别好感'——把语言情感本身作为文明事实呈现
representative_cases_en: Two horses in a race: replacing a metaphor of hierarchy with one of parity—the book's master argument

Quoting the hadith with reservations: gaining legitimacy from the prophetic saying while noting 'if this hadith is sound' and attributing its transmission to two imams—borrowing authority without fabricating it

The stated purpose: scholars widely agree the Diwan aimed to teach Arabs Turkic and to show the language was 'as strong as Arabic and not inferior in social importance,' bringing Turkic into the knowledge world of contemporary Islamic civilization

An observation on linguistic dignity: 'the Turks greatly honour their language and show a special disposition to those who speak Turkic'—presenting linguistic sentiment itself as a civilizational fact

品牌与地区的对等定位
学术话语权与标准参与
modern_applications_en: International expression strategies for underrepresented cultures
Parity positioning for brands and regions

domain_zh: 战略情境判断/传播定位
definition_zh: 为知识工程选择最能产生现实影响的地点、语言、赞助者与时机。约1057年宫廷政变后流亡的喀什噶里，1072-1077年选择在巴格达完成《词典》——这里是阿拔斯哈里发的驻地、伊斯兰世界的知识中心，又是突厥势力（塞尔柱）军事庇护下正在'突厥化'的权力核心；他以阿拉伯语书写并将书献给哈里发穆克塔迪；在内容上对政治上升期的乌古斯-塞尔柱集团给予特别篇幅（记录22个乌古斯部落名与畜印），而对其他部落仅列梗概。此方法的核心逻辑：知识工程要落地，必须读懂时代权力格局，把作品放到决策者的耳边与下一代人的书架上。
definition_en: Choose the venue, language, patron and timing that maximize a knowledge project's real-world impact. After his exile in the 1057 coup, al-Kashgari chose Baghdad to complete the Diwan in 1072-1077—the seat of the Abbasid caliph, the knowledge center of the Islamic world, and a power core being 'Turkicized' under Seljuk military protection; he wrote in Arabic and dedicated the book to Caliph al-Muqtadi; and he gave special space to the politically ascendant Oghuz-Seljuk group (recording 22 Oghuz tribal names and tamgas) while other tribes received only summaries. Core logic: to land a knowledge project, read the era's power structure and place the work within earshot of decision-makers and on the shelves of the next generation.
source_chapter: TDK Kâşgarlı Mahmud 条目（献书哈里发穆克塔迪）；Turkic Studies Journal（Tchoroev 2026：书成于阿拔斯中心巴格达、塞尔柱政治控制时期）；Türk Maarif Ansiklopedisi（乌古斯篇幅之政治动因）；英文维基 Mahmud al-Kashgari；linearhistory 条目（家族随 Terken Hatun 迁入伊拉克之说）
key_quote_zh: 接近他们最好的方式，就是用他们自己的语言说话——由此让他们侧耳倾听、倾心接受。
key_quote_en: There is no better way to approach them than by speaking their own tongue, thereby bending their ear and inclining their heart.
process_zh: 判断时局：突厥势力（塞尔柱）上升、阿拔斯宫廷受其庇护，伊斯兰世界需要了解突厥
选择落脚点：定居巴格达——知识中心、权力中心、翻译与学术市场交汇之地
选择媒介：以阿拉伯语写作，让最大范围的读者可直接使用本书
确定献呈对象：将书献给在位哈里发穆克塔迪，把私人学术变成公共知识事件
内容重点倾斜：为政治上升期的乌古斯部族单列详章（部落名、畜印、地理）
踩准时间点：1071年曼齐刻尔特战役后突厥浪潮正盛之际完成并呈递
process_en: Read the times: Turkic (Seljuk) power ascendant, the Abbasid court under its protection, the Islamic world in need of knowledge about the Turks
Choose the base: settle in Baghdad—a hub of knowledge, power, translation and scholarly markets
Choose the medium: write in Arabic so the widest readership can use the book directly
Fix the dedicatee: present the work to the reigning caliph al-Muqtadi, turning private scholarship into a public knowledge event
Tilt the content: give the politically rising Oghuz a dedicated detailed chapter (tribe names, tamgas, geography)
Hit the moment: finish and present it as the Turkic wave surged after the 1071 Battle of Manzikert
representative_cases_zh: 巴格达之选：政变流亡者没有停留在故地，而是把学术工程带进当时伊斯兰世界的中心巴格达——同时靠近权力、读者与赞助
献书哈里发：成书后献给阿拔斯哈里发阿布·卡西姆·阿卜杜拉·穆克塔迪（al-Muqtadi），并自述'奉哈里发之命'写作——以制度性承认提升作品的权威等级
乌古斯现象：书中详细记录22个乌古斯部落名称与牲畜印记，研究者指出此倾斜与塞尔柱苏丹阿尔普·阿尔斯兰军队的扩张直接相关——内容跟着权力现实走
时间窗口：1071年曼齐刻尔特战役突厥大胜、1072年1月开笔——写作恰逢突厥进入伊斯兰核心区的最新时刻
representative_cases_en: The choice of Baghdad: rather than staying in his homeland, the exiled scholar carried his project to the center of the Islamic world—close at once to power, readership and patronage

Dedicating to the caliph: the finished work was presented to Abbasid Caliph Abu al-Qasim Abdullah al-Muqtadi, and he states he wrote 'by the caliph's command'—raising the work's authority through institutional recognition

The Oghuz focus: the book records in detail the names and livestock tamgas of 22 Oghuz tribes; scholars link this tilt directly to the expansion of Seljuk Sultan Alp Arslan's armies—content following political reality
The timing window: started in January 1072, months after the Turks' 1071 victory at Manzikert—written exactly as the Turkic wave entered the Islamic core

面向决策者的知识产品（政策简报/白皮书）
发布时机与渠道选择
modern_applications_en: Contextual positioning for research and product initiatives
Knowledge products for decision-makers (policy briefs, white papers)
Timing and channel selection for release

verification.evidence: TDK 条目；Tchoroev (2026)；Türk Maarif Ansiklopedisi（乌古斯篇幅动因）；linearhistory；英文维基 Mahmud al-Kashgari

definition_zh: 不把词典做成纯词汇表，而把语言、历史、地理、民俗、文学、谱系、信仰与器物整合进同一部著作：从语词出发，却为条目尽可能补充部落谱系、地域方位、制度组织、习俗信仰与生活细节，并以诗歌、谚语、传说作为佐证。《词典》因此同时是一部语法书、方言志、民族志、地理志与文学选本，被后世称为'百科全书式词典，乃至百科全书'。此方法的核心逻辑：单个词条是入口，完整文明图景才是出口——知识的价值在于建立条目之间的关联网络。
definition_en: Do not make a mere word list: integrate language, history, geography, customs, literature, genealogy, beliefs and artefacts into one work. Starting from words, the entries expand into tribal genealogies, locations, institutions, ritual, belief and daily life, supported by verses, proverbs and legends. The Diwan is thus at once a grammar, a dialect survey, an ethnography, a geography and a literary anthology—later called 'an encyclopedic dictionary, even an encyclopedia.' Core logic: the single entry is the entrance; the full civilizational picture is the exit—value lies in the network of connections between entries.
source_chapter: TDK《Dîvânu Lugâti't-Türk》条目（'ansiklopedik sözlük, hatta ansiklopedi'）；Dankoff & Kelly (1982) Foreword（'single most important source... also a vital source for Central Asian history and ethnography'）；Türk Maarif Ansiklopedisi；Dankoff 专题研究《Kashgari on the Beliefs and Superstitions of the Turks》
key_quote_zh: 喀什噶里这部11世纪的百科全书式词典，是突厥历史语言学最重要的单一文献，也是中亚历史与民族志的关键来源，更是伊斯兰语言文化的独特样本。
key_quote_en: Kashgari's eleventh-century encyclopedic dictionary is the single most important source in Turkic historical linguistics, also a vital source for Central Asian history and ethnography, and a unique example of Islamic linguistic culture.
process_zh: 以词典为骨架：确立语词条目为主干结构
向外延伸词条：为专名、部落名、地名补充背景说明
纳入谱系与地理：记录部落起源传说与由西向东的分布
纳入制度与民俗：畜印、游戏、饮食、器物、信仰与禁忌
以文学佐证：每条尽可能配以诗歌、谚语、传说实例
交叉关联：使语言、历史、地理、民俗互为注解
process_en: Use the dictionary as the skeleton: set lexical entries as the backbone
Extend each entry outward: add background to proper names, tribal names and places
Include genealogy and geography: record origin legends and the west-to-east distribution
Include institutions and custom: tamgas, games, food, implements, beliefs and taboos
Support with literature: add verses, proverbs or legends wherever possible
Cross-link everything: let language, history, geography and custom annotate one another
representative_cases_zh: 部落谱系与地理：记录'突厥人源于诺亚之子雅弗之子突厥'的谱系传说，并给出二十部落自拜占庭边境至中国的方位序列
乌古斯制度志：部族分支、名称与牲畜印记（damga）的完整清单——既是语言材料也是政治-军事制度记录
生活百科：马匹的数十种名称、羊只分类、游戏（如猜谜、儿童游戏）、饮食与器物词汇——被研究者视为草原生活的三维切片
信仰与习俗：Dankoff 专文《Kashgari on the Beliefs and Superstitions of the Turks》即从《词典》辑出大量信仰与禁忌记录
representative_cases_en: Genealogy and geography: records the legend tracing the Turks to Turk son of Yafes son of Noah, and lists the twenty tribes' positions from the Byzantine frontier to China
Oghuz institutions: a full inventory of tribal branches, names and livestock tamgas—both linguistic material and a record of politico-military organization
Everyday encyclopedia: dozens of horse names, classifications of sheep, games, food and implement vocabulary—read by scholars as a three-dimensional slice of steppe life
Beliefs and customs: Dankoff's study 'Kashgari on the Beliefs and Superstitions of the Turks' draws numerous belief and taboo records from the Diwan
modern_applications_zh: 一体化知识产品与知识中台设计
机构知识资产的结构化整合
行业百科与标准术语库建设
modern_applications_en: Integrated knowledge products and knowledge-platform design
Structured integration of institutional knowledge assets
Industry encyclopedias and standard terminology bases

verification.evidence: TDK DLT 条目；Dankoff & Kelly (1982) Foreword；Türk Maarif Ansiklopedisi；Dankoff (1975) JAOS 论文

definition_zh: 在口传传统被定居化与波斯化冲刷之前，把突厥诸部的口头文学作品就地采样、以文字固化：约290条谚语格言、240余段诗歌（四行诗覆盖史诗、牧歌、训诫、抒情、挽歌各体）、民歌与挽歌被辑入词典，与词条互为佐证。其中包括现存最古老的突厥挽歌《阿尔普·艾尔·通阿》。此方法的核心逻辑：口传传统随风而逝，写作即抢救；保存与研究必须趁它还活着时从吟诵者口中采录，而不依赖后世转抄。
definition_en: Before oral tradition was eroded by settlement and Persianization, sample the Turkic tribes' oral literature on the spot and fix it in writing: some 290 proverbs and maxims, over 240 verse passages (quatrains across epic, pastoral, didactic, lyric and elegiac genres), folk songs and laments were embedded in the dictionary and used to gloss the entries. They include the oldest surviving Turkic elegy, for Alp Er Tunga. Core logic: oral tradition vanishes with the wind, writing is rescue; preservation and study must take the material from singers' mouths while it is still alive, not rely on later copying.
source_chapter: DLT 前言（诗歌谚语引用宣言）；英文维基 Dīwān Lughāt al-Turk / Mahmud al-Kashgari（四行诗各体裁）；iie.kz（291条谚语、约300段歌谣统计）；Literature Atlas（'鄂尔浑碑铭之外最古老的突厥文学实体'）；Alp Er Tunga 条目（挽歌文本）
key_quote_zh: 阿尔普·艾尔·通阿死去了吗？这荒凉的世界留住了吗？命运索回了它的债吗？此刻，心在被撕裂。
key_quote_en: Did Alp Er Tunga die? Has this desolate world remained? Has fate taken its revenge? Now the heart is torn asunder.
process_zh: 锁定载体：诗歌、谚语、挽歌、民歌、史诗片段——口头传统的主要形态
现场采录：在与部落的共同生活中记录吟诵与讲唱的原始文本
按类归档：将材料按史诗、牧歌、训诫、抒情、挽歌等体裁区分
以文佐词：让每段谚语诗歌成为词条释义的用法例句
抢救性书写：赶在传统流失之前完成文字化固定
代际传递：借词典的传抄体系让口头作品进入书面传统
process_en: Identify the carriers: verse, proverbs, laments, folk songs, epic fragments—the main forms of oral tradition
Record in situ: capture original recited and sung texts while living among the tribes
Classify by genre: separate materials into epic, pastoral, didactic, lyric and elegiac
Use literature to gloss words: make each proverb or verse an illustrative usage example
Write for rescue: fix the texts in writing before the tradition dissipates
Transmit across generations: carry oral works into the written tradition via the dictionary's copying system
representative_cases_zh: 挽歌《阿尔普·艾尔·通阿》：被公认为现存最古老的突厥诗歌之一（sagu 体），挽悼与波斯史诗中阿甫拉西雅卜对应的英雄，共三节以上完整传世
谚语库：约290条谚语格言被采录，如'刀锈则武士之勇减损，突厥人若沾染伊朗人的生活方式，其血肉也会腐坏'——保存了草原伦理与政治警句
四行诗各体：史诗、牧歌、训诫、抒情、挽歌五类旧体诗皆存样本，后被整理为多组'诗歌组曲'（Dankoff 研究）
统计口径：研究者统计《词典》含291条谚语与约300段歌谣/诗歌（另有242首民歌之说），构成10世纪前突厥口头文学的采样档案
representative_cases_en: The elegy for Alp Er Tunga: widely regarded as one of the oldest surviving Turkic poems (sagu form), mourning the hero identified with Afrasiab in the Persian epic, preserved in full across several stanzas

A proverb bank: some 290 proverbs and maxims recorded, e.g. 'Just as a warrior's effectiveness diminishes when his sword rusts, so a Turk's flesh rots when he takes on Persian ways'—preserving steppe ethics and political maxims
Quatrains of every genre: samples of epic, pastoral, didactic, lyric and elegiac old verse, later reconstructed into verse cycles (Dankoff's studies)
The scale: scholars count 291 proverbs and around 300 song/verse passages (a Chinese source counts 242 folk songs)—a sampling archive of pre-10th-century Turkic oral literature
modern_applications_zh: 非物质文化遗产抢救性记录
口述史与田野访谈项目
濒危知识的数字化固化
modern_applications_en: Urgent recording of intangible cultural heritage
Oral history and field interview projects

verification.evidence: DLT 前言（Dankoff 转引）；iie.kz；Literature Atlas；Alp Er Tunga（英文维基/Wikiwand）

definition_zh: 以一幅圆形世界地图把突厥世界放到认知的中心：地图以东方为上、以巴拉沙衮-伊塞克湖一带为中心，标注部落位置、城市、山川、海域与'世界环海'；用颜色系统区分水系、海洋、沙漠、山脉与城镇（蓝河、绿海、浅黄沙漠、红山、黄城）；越靠边缘比例越小。这是世界现存最早的突厥世界地图，与词典正文互为经纬。此方法的核心逻辑：地图不是中立的插图，而是世界观的扬声器——谁在地图中央，谁就是叙述的主体；空间化能让分散的知识一眼成图。
definition_en: Use a circular world map to place the Turkic world at the cognitive center: the map is oriented with East at the top and centered on the Balasagun-Issyk-Kul area, marking tribal positions, cities, mountains, rivers, seas and the world-encircling ocean; a colour system distinguishes rivers, seas, deserts, mountains and settlements (blue rivers, green seas, pale-yellow deserts, red mountains, yellow cities); scale shrinks toward the edges. It is the earliest known Turkic world map, serving as warp to the dictionary's weft. Core logic: a map is not a neutral illustration but a loudspeaker for a worldview—whoever stands at the center is the subject of the narrative; spatialization turns scattered knowledge into a single picture.
source_chapter: 《词典》卷首地图（存伊斯坦布尔 Millet Genel Kütüphanesi）；danstopicals.com 地图说明（East at top；色彩系统；中心与边距比例）；mapcompanion.org（牛津地图指南 Map #27）；中文维基麻赫穆德·喀什噶里条目（'地图上方指向东方'）；英文维基 Mahmud al-Kashgari
key_quote_zh: 地图以东方为上，比例尺越靠近边缘越小；巴拉沙衮被置于世界的中心。
key_quote_en: The map is oriented with East at the top. The scale is reduced as one gets nearer the edge of the map. Balasaghun [is] the center of the world.
process_zh: 确立投影：以东方为上、圆形构图，打破当时通行地图的方位惯例
选定中心：以突厥腹地（巴拉沙衮-伊塞克湖）为世界的中心
编码信息：用颜色分类自然与人文要素，让读者一眼识别
标注清单：逐一标出部落、城市、山脉、河流与海域
边缘处理：远端区域缩小比例，形成'中心-边缘'的叙事张力
图文互证：地图与词典条目互相引用，双向检索
process_en: Fix the projection: East at top, circular composition—breaking the cartographic conventions of the day
Choose the center: the Turkic heartland (Balasagun-Issyk-Kul) as the center of the world
Encode information: classify natural and human features by colour for instant reading
Label the inventory: tribes, cities, mountains, rivers and seas marked one by one
Handle the edges: shrink scale at the periphery, creating a center-periphery narrative tension
Cross-reference text and image: map and entries cite each other for two-way lookup
representative_cases_zh: 圆图结构：以巴拉沙衮为中心，东部（中国、日本）居上，西至拜占庭边境与埃及，南见锡兰'阿丹足迹'，边缘为'环海'与歌革-玛各之墙——11世纪突厥视角的世界全图
色彩系统：蓝色标河、绿色标海、浅黄标沙漠、红色标山脉、黄色标城市与人群——中世纪信息可视化的成熟设计
信息密度：图上逐一标注部落分布（二十部）、主要城市（喀什噶尔、巴拉沙衮、撒马尔罕、塔什干等）与地理要素，被研究者称为当时'最完备的突厥世界地图'
复制流传：该图随词典唯一抄本存世，今藏伊斯坦布尔，成为突厥学与地图史研究的孤本材料
representative_cases_en: The circular structure: centered on Balasagun, with the east (China, Japan) at the top, reaching west to the Byzantine frontier and Egypt, south to Ceylon's 'Footprint of Adam,' and edged by the encircling ocean and the wall of Gog and Magog—an 11th-century Turkic view of the whole world
A colour system: blue for rivers, green for seas, pale yellow for deserts, red for mountains, yellow for cities and peoples—a mature design of medieval information visualization

Information density: tribal distributions (twenty tribes), major cities (Kashgar, Balasagun, Samarkand, Tashkent and more) and physical features are all marked—described by scholars as the most complete Turkic world map of its time
Survival: the map survives with the dictionary's unique manuscript in Istanbul, a unicum for Turkology and the history of cartography
modern_applications_zh: 知识图谱与认知地图设计
以我为主的叙事性可视化
战略沙盘与地理信息表达
modern_applications_en: Narrative visualization from one's own vantage point
Strategic sand tables and geographic information expression

verification.evidence: danstopicals.com；mapcompanion.org（Oxford Map Companion #27）；中文维基百科；英文维基百科

definition_zh: 把语言本身当作历史档案：通过词源、部落名、地名、人名与口头记忆重建历史图景——记录'突厥'之名的谱系传说；给出部落自拜占庭边境至中国的空间序列以还原族群分布；对巴尔思汗等地名保留多重词源传说；以挽歌保存英雄记忆（阿尔普·艾尔·通阿即波斯史诗中的阿甫拉西雅卜）；以战歌保存于阗征服等历史事件。此方法的核心逻辑：在文献稀少的时代，语言是最完整的历史证词——词根里藏着迁徙路线，名字里藏着政权兴替，歌谣里藏着战争与哀悼。
definition_en: Treat language itself as a historical archive: reconstruct the past from etymologies, tribal names, toponyms, personal names and oral memory—recording the genealogical legend of the name 'Turk'; mapping tribal positions from the Byzantine frontier to China to recover ethnic distribution; preserving multiple etymologies of names like Barsgan; keeping heroic memory in elegy (Alp Er Tunga, identified with Afrasiab of the Persian epic); and preserving events such as the conquest of Khotan in war verses. Core logic: in ages poor in documents, language is the most complete historical testimony—roots hide migration routes, names hide dynastic turns, songs hide wars and mourning.
source_chapter: DLT 部族与地理章节（转引自 TDK 条目、Türk Maarif Ansiklopedisi）；中文维基麻赫穆德·喀什噶里；英文维基 Mahmud al-Kashgari / Alp Er Tunga；TDK Barsgan 词源两说；dokumen.pub《From Mahmud Kaşgari to Evliya Çelebi》（于阗诗与诗歌组曲研究）
key_quote_zh: 从最靠近拜占庭的部落开始，我按由西向东的顺序，把异教徒与穆斯林部落一一排列：最近的佩切涅格，然后钦察、乌古斯、耶麦克、巴什基尔、拔悉密、Kay、牙巴库、鞑靼、柯尔克孜……再往东是奇吉尔、托赫西、亚格马、乌古拉克、察鲁克、丘穆尔、回鹘、唐古特、契丹。
key_quote_en: Starting from the tribe nearest Rum (Byzantium), I arranged the tribes, both unbelievers and Muslims, in order eastward: nearest is Pecheneg, then Kipchak, Oghuz, Yemek, Bashkir, Basmyl, Kay, Yabaku, Tatar, Kyrgyz... then Chigil, Tukhsi, Yagma, Ughrak, Charuk, Chumul, Uyghur, Tangut, and Khitai in China.
process_zh: 收集名物：把部落名、地名、人名、族称全部纳入词条
保留异说：对同一名称并录多种词源传说，不强行裁断
空间排序：以由西向东的地理序列重建族群分布图
以歌证事：用挽歌、战歌、谚语保存的历史记忆佐证史实
比对旁证：与阿拉伯-波斯地理文献及口头传统互相校验
输出叙事：把碎片按时序与地序拼成可讲述的历史
process_en: Collect the name-material: gather tribal, place and personal names and ethnonyms as entries
Keep variants: record multiple etymological legends for one name without forcing a verdict
Order spatially: rebuild ethnic distribution through a west-to-east geographic sequence
Let songs witness: corroborate history with memory preserved in elegies, war verses and proverbs
Cross-check sources: test against Arabic-Persian geographical literature and oral tradition
Produce a narrative: piece fragments into a tellable history along time and space
representative_cases_zh: 巴尔思汗词源两说：既记'名自阿甫拉西雅卜之子、建城者以此命名'，又记'名自回鹘可汗的马夫巴尔思汗'——并存异说，保存了地名记忆的层次
阿尔普·艾尔·通阿：挽歌保存的英雄被与波斯史诗《列王纪》中的阿甫拉西雅卜对应，成为突厥-伊朗共享英雄记忆的关键文本
于阗征服诗：以战歌形式保存喀喇汗王朝征服于阗（10-11世纪）的历史事件，成为研究该战争的诗体旁证
族源谱系：记录'突厥为诺亚之子雅弗之子突厥之后'的谱系学叙事，反映11世纪突厥知识分子自我定位的历史想象
奇吉尔名称传说：录'双角王（祖勒卡尔奈因）见泥泞而筑城得名'的民间词源——把传说本身作为文化史料保存
representative_cases_en: Two etymologies of Barsgan: both 'named after a son of Afrasiab who founded the city' and 'named after the Uyghur kagan's horse-groom Barshgan' are recorded—preserving layers of toponymic memory without forcing a verdict
Alp Er Tunga: the hero preserved in elegy is identified with Afrasiab of the Persian Shahnameh, a key text of shared Turco-Iranian heroic memory
The Khotan conquest verses: war songs preserving the Karakhanid conquest of Khotan (10th-11th c.), a poetic witness for the study of that campaign
Genealogical legend: the narrative tracing the Turks to Turk son of Yafes son of Noah, reflecting the historical imagination of 11th-century Turkic intellectuals
The name Chigil: the folk etymology of 'Dhul-Qarnayn founding the city in the mud' is recorded—legend itself preserved as cultural source-material
modern_applications_zh: 词源与名称史的考证方法
口述史料与文献互证
品牌与族群的源流研究

verification.evidence: TDK Barsgan 条目；Dankoff《From Mahmud Kaşgari to Evliya Çelebi》；中文/英文维基；TDK DLT 条目

name_zh: 学习者导向教学编排法
definition_zh: 为'让阿拉伯人学会突厥语'这一目标设计完整学习路径：先语法后词典；词条按结构由简入繁（二字母词起步，递进至七字母）；每条尽可能配诗歌谚语实例示范用法；编排以'查得着'为硬标准（'让使用者按字母顺序在正确的位置找到要查的词'）；并把提炼出的'方言法则'当作教学核心——他自称这是'诸方言法则的炼金术'，学习者一旦记住原则便能自行推导未见之词。此外他还撰有配套语法书《突厥语语法精华》（已佚），形成'语法+词典'的学习闭环。此方法的核心逻辑：好的知识产品要从学习者的认知路径出发，以原则授人以渔，而非让人死记硬背。
definition_en: Design a complete learning path for the goal of 'teaching Arabs Turkic': grammar before dictionary; entries graded from simple to complex (starting with two-letter words up to seven); every entry illustrated wherever possible with verses and proverbs; 'findability' as a hard standard ('let the user find the wanted word in its right place by alphabetical order'); and the distilled 'principles of the dialects' as the teaching core—he calls it 'the alchemy of the principles of the dialects,' so that once learners memorize the principles they can deduce unseen words themselves. He also wrote a companion grammar, Kitab Jawahir al-Nahw (lost), closing the grammar-plus-dictionary loop. Core logic: a good knowledge product follows the learner's cognitive path and teaches principles—giving a fishing rod rather than rote learning.
source_chapter: Dankoff & Kelly (1982)（'alchemy of the principles'段，MS.304）；Dogan 论文（字母序编排与'由二至七字母'递进、归纳式教学）；'Sözlüğü kullanan aradığı sözcüğü doğru yerde bulsun...'自述（DLT I.4）；TDK 条目（Kitâbü Cevâhiri'n-Nahv 语法书）
key_quote_zh: 这就是诸方言法则的炼金术。我为它们用掉了许多笔记簿。一旦你记住了这些原则，其余的便能自行推导；只要勤修不忘，从突厥人口中听到的任何词都不会难住你，哪怕你不知道它的词根。你要弄懂！
key_quote_en: This is the alchemy of the principles of the dialects. I have spent many notebooks on their account. Once you have memorized these principles you may deduce the rest on your own accord; so, as long as you are assiduous in learning them, you will not be troubled by any word that you may hear from a Turk, even if you do not know its root. Understand!
process_zh: 确定学习者画像：面向不懂突厥语的阿拉伯读者
先行语法概览：在词典之前先讲书写系统与语法规则
由简入繁：按二、三、四……七字母递进组织词条，形成难度梯度
强化可查找性：字母序+结构分类，使查检路径稳定可预期
以例示范：每条尽可能配诗歌谚语，让用法可感
授人以渔：提炼可推导的原则体系，让学习者能独立处理新词
配套闭环：另撰语法专书，与词典互相支撑
process_en: Profile the learner: Arabic readers with no Turkic
Front-load grammar: teach script and grammatical rules before the dictionary
Grade difficulty: order entries from two- to seven-letter words, creating a gradient
Maximize findability: alphabetical plus structural classification for a stable lookup path
Teach by example: illustrate entries with verses and proverbs wherever possible
Teach principles: distil a derivable rule system so learners can handle new words alone
Close the loop: write a companion grammar to support the dictionary
representative_cases_zh: 先语法后词典：全书结构为'前言-语法综述-八卷词典'，让读者先掌握规则再查检词汇
难度递进：每卷内先二字母词、继而三字母、四字母直至七字母词条——被研究者称为'归纳式教学'的安排
可查找性标准：自述'我把每个词按字母顺序放好，让人能在正确位置找到它，并以散文与诗句、谚语、箴言和优雅的语言加以装饰'——把检索体验写进编纂目标
原则教学：把方言规则提炼为'炼金术'般的原理体系，声明记住原则即可自行推导陌生词
配套教材：《突厥语语法精华》虽已佚，但其存在证明'词典+语法'的双教材设计意图
representative_cases_en: Grammar before dictionary: the structure runs preface-grammar-dictionary in eight books, letting readers master rules before looking up words
Graded difficulty: each book moves from two-letter words to three-, four- and up to seven-letter entries—described by scholars as an inductive pedagogical arrangement

The findability standard: 'I arranged every word alphabetically so the user may find it in its right place, adorned with prose and verse, proverbs, maxims and elegant language'—search experience written into the compilation goal
Teaching principles: dialect rules distilled into an 'alchemy'-like system, with the claim that memorizing them lets learners derive unknown words
A companion textbook: the lost Kitab Jawahir al-Nahw proves the 'dictionary + grammar' twin-text design
modern_applications_zh: 教材与课程结构设计
知识库信息架构（可查找性）
原则式学习与能力迁移

verification.evidence: Dankoff & Kelly (1982) MS.304 段；Dogan 论文；TDK 条目；DLT I.4 自述
